body:
Native same-parent response admission is now independently verified and published in [Presto family0612](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/84b1e593bf8ffd8effc642ea32b93422e13b9a99/experiments/2026-10-25_0612_codex_native-contrast-admission/README.md). [Recipe PR #841](https://github.com/pirl-unc/hitlist/pull/841) preserves all 10,647 source dispositions and yields 228 contrasts from 82 parent sequences across 81 original dependency components. The frozen hash split supplies 55/8/18 components and 158/38/32 contrasts for train/validation/test, meeting the unchanged support gate; validation is exactly at its component minimum.

Every target is one unpaired difference of within-run log10 peptide/reference ratios, with all six ratios and 2,736 total measurement contributions preserved. Independent original TSV/FASTA/origin replay checks eligibility, original quantities, annotations, reference/split rules, targets and weights. Source-wide ambiguous/excluded dependencies remain; zeros are not negative labels, modified/matching support stays annotated, and HEK293T raw signal is not APC molarity.

Current recipe 90a7a62 passes format/lint and 3,547 local tests plus unchanged-package public replay. Hosted docs/lint/Python 3.10–3.14 units pass; integration/coverage are pending. Source PR839 is merged; original release build succeeded, but concurrent PR840 advanced main at the same unreleased version, so current-main release 40168710669 is now running before upload. The original verified artifacts are retained.

No predictor was fitted and no held-out effect distribution was summarized. Next is the frozen zero/length/61-feature sequence screen after tested source/recipe releases. Keep this issue open: complete pool recovery, precursor/detection calibration, physical-sample independence and professional-APC transfer remain unresolved.
